fixtureRequirements.description: Temp directory with no existing key file at the specified path

knownParityDivergences: witness --gen-keypair presence probe is tri-state only on C# (Present/Absent/Undetermined, refuses on Undetermined even with --force). Swift fileExists is the documented fail-open mode (M-01 on macOS).
C# prints public key bytes; macOS prints public key bytes. Assert paths/modes/refusals/exit codes, never key bytes (CSPRNG output differs every run).
